title: inference.sh
description: run any ai model. compose agents, stack knowledge, connect tools. one api, pay per run.
summary: run any ai model. compose agents, stack knowledge, connect tools. one api, pay per run.
offersHint: run any ai model. compose agents, stack knowledge, connect tools. one api, pay per run. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://api.inference.sh/mcp

toolsPreview.name: app_get
toolsPreview.description: Get detailed app info including input/output schemas and version history

toolsPreview.name: app_list
toolsPreview.description: Search and filter available apps on inference.sh

toolsPreview.name: app_run
toolsPreview.description: Run an app on inference.sh. Creates a task that executes the app with the given input.

toolsPreview.name: knowledge_create
toolsPreview.description: Create a new knowledge entry (concept, observation, preference, reference, etc.)

toolsPreview.name: knowledge_delete
toolsPreview.description: Delete a knowledge entry by ID

toolsPreview.name: knowledge_get
toolsPreview.description: Get detailed information about a knowledge entry by namespace/name or ID

toolsPreview.name: knowledge_list
toolsPreview.description: List your knowledge entries, optionally filtered by type

toolsPreview.name: knowledge_search
toolsPreview.description: Search your knowledge entries by query

toolsPreview.name: mcp_connect
toolsPreview.description: Initiate a connection to an MCP server. For OAuth servers, returns an authorization URL to open in a browser.

toolsPreview.name: mcp_disconnect
toolsPreview.description: Remove connection to an MCP server

toolsPreview.name: mcp_get
toolsPreview.description: Get details about an MCP server including connection status

toolsPreview.name: mcp_list
toolsPreview.description: Browse available MCP servers that can be connected to

toolsPreview.name: mcp_run
toolsPreview.description: Call a tool on a connected MCP server. The server must be connected first via mcp_connect.

toolsPreview.name: mcp_search
toolsPreview.description: Search available MCP servers by query

toolsPreview.name: mcp_tools
toolsPreview.description: List available tools on a connected MCP server, or get details for a specific tool

toolsPreview.name: skill_files
toolsPreview.description: List supplementary files for a skill (references, scripts, etc.)

toolsPreview.name: skill_search
toolsPreview.description: Search the public skill store

toolsPreview.name: skill_store
toolsPreview.description: Browse approved skills in the public skill store

toolsPreview.name: skill_upload
toolsPreview.description: Create or update a skill with SKILL.md content and optional supporting files

toolsPreview.name: skill_use
toolsPreview.description: Fetch a skill's assembled SKILL.md content. Tries the inference.sh store first, falls back to GitHub. Returns the full skill content for the agent to consume.

toolsPreview.name: skill_view
toolsPreview.description: View a specific supplementary file from a skill's manifest

toolsPreview.name: task_cancel
toolsPreview.description: Cancel a running or queued task

toolsPreview.name: task_get
toolsPreview.description: Get status and output of a task

toolsPreview.name: task_list
toolsPreview.description: List your tasks on inference.sh

toolsPreview.name: task_logs
toolsPreview.description: Get execution logs for a task
